D10_equilibration._verdict: Startup relaxation frames were never discarded; external audit found ubiquitin frames 1-3 scoring 99.7/100 as pure crystal-lattice relaxation. Now auto-detected and cut.

suitability_screen._verdict: ALL systems are single-basin: 100% of frames within 2 A of one medoid. MSM microstates partition thermal noise, not conformational states. This is the root explanation for disconnected states, unresolved pi, and powerless CK tests.

E1_resolved_collinearity._verdict: Residue attribution is now orthogonal to RMSF. Orthogonality is NOT validity - functional-site enrichment (OI-12) remains open.

contradiction_resolved_1UBQ_52_60._verdict: Residues 52-60 are RIGID, not flexible. Our independent measurement (0.53 +/- 0.08 A, implicit solvent) matches external report B (0.57 +/- 0.07 A, explicit solvent GROMACS) despite entirely different simulation conditions. Report A's 'intrinsically flexible' claim (RMSF 1.88-2.08) is WRONG, and so is its stated root cause of general thermal flexibility.
